purpose: Current offline expectation cases for adaptive explanations. Fixture validation is not evidence of live agent routing or learning effectiveness.

cases.prompt: In two sentences, what is queueing delay?
cases.reason: An explicit short answer needs no rendering runtime.

cases.prompt: Compare FIFO, shortest-job-first, and round-robin scheduling by ordering, preemption, and starvation.
cases.reason: Three comparable policies fit a table unless a specific mechanism needs further explanation.

cases.prompt: Draw a graphical map of the inspected gateway, queue, workers, and result store.
cases.reason: A fixed system structure fits the graphical map owner.

cases.prompt: Render this Mermaid source unchanged: flowchart LR; A-->B
cases.reason: The explicit source format takes precedence.

cases.prompt: Help me explore how changing a job's arrival time affects its wait in this single-server FIFO example.
cases.reason: An adjustable input exposes a causal dependency; verify expected waiting times.

cases.prompt: Plot these measured latency values for our systems paper, with source data and reproducible SVG/PDF exports.
cases.reason: Measured research results retain the deterministic publication pipeline.

cases.prompt: Explain the workflow by editing this existing .drawio diagram and preserving its style.
Use OmniGraffle to revise my .graffle mechanism figure; the app probe is currently blocked.
cases.reason: Prepare source as allowed and report the blocker without changing owner.

cases.prompt: Create a short video explaining the inspected request lifecycle.
cases.reason: Requested video delegates to the installed owner and defaults to editable Studio preview.

cases.prompt: Verify this Remotion Studio preview in my available browser; the in-app browser is unavailable.
cases.reason: Disclose the available-browser fallback, inspect the exact local URL, and retain the owner's Studio server and URL for handoff.

cases.prompt: Export an MP4 of the verified explanation composition.
cases.reason: Explicit export selects the video rendering owner and requires checking the produced file.

cases.prompt: Show an adjustable in-conversation queue explanation, but the Visualize owner is unavailable.
cases.reason: Give a useful sourced text trace and disclose that the requested interaction was not produced.

cases.prompt: Create an Archify lifecycle map from this confidential design; keep it local only.
cases.reason: Privacy and explicit local-only intent override a previous sharing opt-in.
